result.summary: Implemented Iteration 3/4 of ISS-0100 tenant fixture hygiene per src/design/iss0100-tenant-fixture-hygiene.md §3.7. Read each file's actual ensureTenantBinding helper directly (design doc's cited line numbers had drifted: actual locations were oidc09 line 126, oidc10 line 111, oidc11 line 139) and confirmed all three share the identical body: unqualified 'INSERT INTO tenant (id, slug, display_name, status, idp_realm_id) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, 'ACTIVE', $4) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET ...' with 4 bound params. Added tenant_type, production_tenant_id to the column list and 'test', $5::uuid to the VALUES list, appending the default-tenant literal '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' as the 5th bound argument in all three files. ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE SET clause left unchanged in every file, per design. ISS-0101 shadow-table risk did NOT recur: unlike adp07/adp04a (Iteration 2), none of these 3 files' makePool() calls api_tenant_context.set(...) before Pool.init() -- verified by reading each file's makePool helper (oidc09 line 49, oidc10 line 45, oidc11's equivalent) -- so pool.zig's applyRequestStorageRouting() takes the no-tenant branch (SET search_path TO public) rather than the tenant-schema branch, meaning the unqualified 'INSERT INTO tenant' correctly resolves to public.tenant with no shadow-table risk. Left unqualified as-is per design instruction not to change qualification style unless the failure recurs. zig build exits 0 with no 'error set' output. oidc09/oidc10/oidc11 are not wired into any zig build test target (not imported by tests/integration/main_test.zig, no matching build.zig step) -- this is a pre-existing build-graph gap unrelated to this fix (oidc12/13/14/15/35 have the same gap; adp07/adp04a from Iteration 2 ARE wired in). Ran the full zig build test-integration suite (superset of Iteration 2's narrower test-integration-svc baseline) after fixing a stale local BPM_TEST_DB_URL shell value (was pointing at port 5433, an unrelated dev-only container; corrected to port 5434 matching the running db_test container and the project's own .env): 103 pre-existing failures, none referencing tenant_type, the tenant table, or shadow-table symptoms -- all trace to unrelated pre-existing gaps (missing dead_letter_queue/onboarding_registry.realm_id/bpm_repository_artifacts_immutable(), snapshot/idempotency-key assertions, tnt schema-isolation fixtures). This is consistent with the failure categories Iteration 1/2 already established as pre-existing and unrelated.
